name: VoiceStudio
description: Optional connector for a separately installed VoiceStudio service.

commands.name: VoiceStudio: clone a reference voice
commands.description: Clone a voice using VoiceStudio (also called VoiceBox / voice box). Required JSON: name, transcript (exact words in the uploaded reference), and exactly one reference_clip_id (get_project clip ID), reference_media_id (library ID), or reference_path (external audio). Use timeline IDs directly; never ask for a path when the clip exists. First transcribe the selected clip with transcribe clip_ids:[id]; use only words matching the reference sample. Optional reference_offset_sec and reference_duration_sec (0.1–30; default first 15 source seconds inside the clip range), language (Auto). Choose a complete utterance and matching transcript; never use the new narration as reference text. Returns voiceId for add_voiceover engine extension:clipcraft.voicestudio.speech. Use clone-and-voiceover when narration is also requested.

commands.name: VoiceStudio: clone voice and add voiceover
commands.description: Clone reference speech and insert new narration through VoiceStudio (VoiceBox / voice box). Required JSON: name, transcript (exact reference words), text (new narration), and exactly one reference_clip_id, reference_media_id, or reference_path. First get_project then transcribe clip_ids:[id]; use existing IDs without asking for paths. Optional reference_offset_sec, reference_duration_sec (0.1–30; default first 15 source seconds), language (Auto), start_sec (0), speed (0.5–2), style. Match transcript to the exact reference window; do not substitute narration. Omit style unless requested; OmniVoice accepts speaker attributes, not free-form tone or pacing prose. Creates a saved profile and one Undo-able audio clip. After any post-clone failure reuse the returned voiceId with add_voiceover; never clone again just to retry speech.

commands.name: VoiceStudio: set reference transcript
commands.description: Update an existing VoiceStudio profile using PUT /profiles/{id}, without creating another clone. Required JSON: voice_id (exact ID from list_voices) and transcript (exact words in that profile’s reference audio, not the requested new narration). Use when a saved clone lacks ref_text. Transcribe its known reference clip first; do not guess which audio belongs to an existing profile. Then reuse voiceId with add_voiceover engine extension:clipcraft.voicestudio.speech. Changes the external saved profile, not the timeline.
